paras: Vishnu and his sister Radha were playing in the park. Vishnu ran fast and stepped on a patch of wet mud. His feet slipped, and he fell down. 'Ouch! Why did I slip?' he asked.
Radha helped him up. 'The mud is smooth and wet,' she said. 'It has less friction. Friction is a force that stops us from sliding. When there is less friction, we slip.'
Later, they went to the kitchen. Radha tried to push a heavy box. It would not move. 'It is too heavy!' she said. Vishnu pushed too, but it still did not move.
'The floor is rough,' said their mother. 'Rough surfaces have more friction. That is why the box does not slide easily. If we put it on wheels, it will move.'
In the evening, they played with a ball. Vishnu rolled the ball on the smooth floor. It went far. Then he rolled it on the rough carpet. It stopped quickly.
'The carpet has more friction,' said Radha. 'It slows the ball down. The smooth floor has less friction, so the ball rolls farther.'
Before bed, Vishnu was thinking. 'So friction helps us walk and hold things. But it also makes us slip on mud and ice. It can be good and bad.'
Radha smiled. 'Yes! That is why we wear shoes with good grip on rainy days. And we use oil on machines to reduce friction.' Vishnu learned something new that day.

items.q: Why did Vishnu slip on the mud?
items.a: Because wet mud is smooth and has less friction, so his feet slid.

items.q: Why was it hard to push the heavy box on the floor?
items.a: Because the rough floor has more friction, which makes it hard to slide the box.

items.q: Where did the ball roll farther — on the smooth floor or on the carpet? Why?
items.a: On the smooth floor. It has less friction, so the ball rolls farther.

items.q: Give one example where friction is helpful and one where it is not.
items.a: Helpful: Friction helps us walk without slipping. Not helpful: Friction makes it hard to push heavy things.

sections.heading: B. Match the situation with the correct reason.

items.r: Less friction on a smooth, wet surface.

items.l: A heavy box does not move easily.
items.r: More friction on a rough surface.

items.l: A ball rolls far on the floor.
items.r: Less friction on a smooth surface.

items.l: You wear shoes with good grip on rainy days.
items.r: To increase friction and stop slipping.
